ultrasound was also performed to rule out an infection around 
the kidney or evidence of obstruction. the ultrasound was also

burning with urination, blood in your urine or if your symptoms

radiology_notes.text:
CLINICAL INDICATION:  History of chronic UTIs and recurrent pyelonephritis.

TECHNIQUE:  Grayscale and limited color Doppler imaging of the kidneys was
performed.  Comparison exam is dated ___.

FINDINGS:  The right kidney measures 9.3 cm, and the left kidney measures 9.6
cm.  Again seen is mild right pelvicaliectasis, which is stable.  There is
mild fullness of the left renal pelvis.  There is no frank hydronephrosis, and
there is no focal renal lesion or fluid collection.  The bladder is partially
decompressed and circumferentially thick-walled.

IMPRESSION:  No evidence of renal abscess.  Stable mild right
pelvicaliectasis.
